track.title: Repair quarantine recovery architecture
track.purpose: Resume the durable repair lifecycle design without treating target models as implemented behavior.
track.operating_mode: contract-first architecture; no destructive runtime action
track.active_scope: node operations, repair lifecycle, operator evidence
track.current_objective: Define the smallest safe repair state and action contract before API, schema, or runtime implementation.
decisions: Heartbeat loss alone is not proof for destructive cleanup.
Typed repair actions require explicit impact, authorization, rollback, and evidence.
next_actions: Map lifecycle states and repair types into one reviewed contract.
